key.name: start-date
key.summary: Start date of the first sprint
key.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format on which the first sprint begins. Sprints are counted forward from this date in fixed blocks.

key.name: sprint-length-weeks
key.description: How long each sprint is, in weeks.

key.name: first-sprint-number
key.summary: Sprint number at the start date
key.description: The sprint number that the sprint starting on the start date has. Useful if your team is already on sprint 42.

key.name: sprint-display
key.summary: What to show next to the sprint number
key.description: "day" shows a day counter (e.g. "Day 3/14"), "bar" shows a progress bar for the sprint, "none" shows only the sprint number.
